fluff.overview: Mechanized wheeled squads transport a squad-strength infantry element in wheeled APCs, optimized for speed on roads and developed surfaces. These small, mobile formations handle checkpoint security, convoy escort, highway patrol, and urban rapid-response duties where road speed matters more than off-road capability. Cheaper to operate than tracked alternatives and faster on pavement, wheeled squads trade rough-terrain performance for economical, high-speed coverage of garrison zones with good infrastructure.
